title: Remove Landing Page troubleshooting access issues section

requirements.text: Remove the entire “Troubleshooting Access Issues” section from the unauthenticated Landing page, including its heading, explanatory text about “Canister ID Not Resolved” / “Error 400”, the displayed URL `https://genz-app.icp0.io`, and the step-by-step instructions list.
acceptanceCriteria: The Landing page no longer renders a section titled “Troubleshooting Access Issues”.
No Landing page content mentions “Canister ID Not Resolved” or “Error 400”.
No Landing page content displays the URL `https://genz-app.icp0.io` as part of troubleshooting guidance.
The page layout still renders correctly with the remaining sections (Hero, Platform Stats, Featured Providers, Testimonials, Features, About) in the expected order.

requirements.text: Clean up any unused imports or code left behind by removing the troubleshooting section from `frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx` (for example, remove the `AlertCircle` icon import if it is no longer used).
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx` has no unused imports related to the removed troubleshooting section.
The frontend builds without lint/type errors caused by the removal.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not change the service worker, PWA manifest, or `.well-known/ic-domains` behavior as part of this change.
nonGoals: Do not add replacement troubleshooting content elsewhere in the app.
Do not change the existing Landing page CTA behavior (e.g., “Get Started” login flow, “Learn More” scroll target) except as required to remove the troubleshooting section.
